**In one line**: Elon Musk has reportedly urged leading AI labs and Chinese companies to test each other's models.

### Key points
- Musk proposed that leading US and Chinese AI developers **cross-check each other's models** rather than relying on internal evaluation alone.
- The remarks come amid growing **calls to slow down** the pace of AI development.
- The idea frames safety review as a shared responsibility, assuming cooperation between otherwise competing firms.

### Why it matters
The suggestion reflects unease with letting individual labs be the sole judges of their own frontier models' risks. If realized, it could mark a first instance of US–China AI safety cooperation — though trade secrets and geopolitical tension make it far from certain.
